markers.title: Jason's house
markers.desc: Jason's waterfront home, lent to him by Brian Heder. Your first save point and cash stash. Four house projects here are missable: finish them before Coming Home.

markers.title: House projects (missable)
markers.desc: Steps, roof, railing and bedroom wall at Jason's house. They lock once you pick Lucia up in Coming Home. The railing is at the back, by the outdoor gym, next to a ladder.

markers.title: Three Sheets liquor: Strange Noises
markers.desc: Finish Shirley's rum errand first, then check the strange noises out back. Clear the guards and loot the hidden stash.

markers.title: Chuck's Tackle & Shot
markers.desc: An Ammu-Nation east of Jason's house. The first place to buy a face covering (gaiters and bandanas).

markers.title: Fleeca bank, Key Lento
markers.desc: A small bank job ($5k to $20k, per PowerPyx). Small banks unlock after Credit Check.

markers.title: Brian (fence)
markers.desc: Buys narcotics after Lab Fees. Gone after Chapter 1. Hover his icon in-game to compare his price with Donnie's.

markers.title: Donnie (fence)
markers.desc: Early buyer for product. Gone after the main mission Swamped.

markers.title: Kenton's treasure dives
markers.desc: Unlocks after Island Dreams. Kenton pays once he sells your finds, which can take a few hours. Early wrecks are worth about $1,400.

markers.title: Kingfishers: Fishing Shacks
markers.desc: The first Illegal Operation most players find. A full loot is worth close to $2,000, and there's a free Unique Weapon Variant in the dock house.

markers.title: Lost drug packages (×4)
markers.desc: After Clean Up After Donnie, Cal marks four sites around the Keys, each worth about $900. Two duffel bags hold all four. Bring an off-road vehicle.

markers.title: Crashed plane near Hamlet
markers.desc: Look for smoke in a field south of Hamlet. You'll find a pistol and sellable drugs, then an armed truck shows up.

markers.title: Moses' garage
markers.desc: Buys cars without trackers for roughly $1,000 to $3,000, with about two minutes between sales. He won't take cars stolen near his garage.

markers.title: Dunk (fence)
markers.desc: A second fence, unlocked after Slam Dunk.

markers.title: La Cascara Motel
markers.desc: An Illegal Operation that Vice rates among the best earners in Chapter 2.

markers.title: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range
markers.desc: Buy the $5 waiver and repeat Market Range Beginner to train Focus fast (per PowerPyx). Shooting ranges also unlock the ammo cheats.

markers.title: Allied Crystal sugar refinery
markers.desc: Ambrosia's industrial heart, named by Rockstar in its description of the region.

markers.title: Shorefront bank, Ambrosia
markers.desc: A small bank job ($5k to $15k, per PowerPyx).

markers.title: Train tunnel (lose helicopters)
markers.desc: PowerPyx's tip for losing police helicopters at 4+ stars: follow the wilderness train tracks here.

markers.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
markers.desc: Hunting, fishing and off-road trails, per Rockstar. Fishing and hunting also train Focus.

markers.title: Bigfoot sightings
markers.desc: Players have reported a Bigfoot encounter in Leonida's swamps. There's also a stranger mission strand about the Skunk Ape.

markers.title: Ocean Beach
markers.desc: Vice City's beachfront, with four of the eight bank vaults (per PowerPyx) and a hidden trophy for enjoying a cocktail with a view.

markers.title: VC Port
markers.desc: Rockstar calls it the cruise-ship capital of the world.

markers.title: Lombank vault, Downtown
markers.desc: One of the two richest vaults: $135k to $205k (per PowerPyx). Robbing it gives an instant 4-star wanted level.

markers.title: Fleeca vault, Downtown
markers.desc: Bank vault worth $100k to $150k (per PowerPyx).

markers.title: Lombank vault, Ocean Beach
markers.desc: One of the two richest vaults: $135k to $205k (per PowerPyx). PowerPyx lists a second Lombank in Ocean Beach worth $75k to $135k.

markers.title: Shorefront vault, Ocean Beach
markers.desc: Bank vault worth $95k to $140k (per PowerPyx).

markers.title: Fleeca vault, VCIA
markers.desc: Bank vault worth $100k to $150k (per PowerPyx). VCIA is also where the hidden Catch Me If You Can trophy happens.

markers.title: Yasmani (fence)
markers.desc: Pays well for jewelry and marked bills, and starts the jewelry-store jobs ($10k to $25k each). Later sells security-van tips for $10,000.

markers.title: Tyrone (fence)
markers.desc: Pays the best rate for narcotics (per PowerPyx's fence ratings).

markers.title: Randy (wish-list cars)
markers.desc: Pays $30,000+ for wish-list supercars in perfect condition. You'll need the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.

markers.title: Tisha-Wocka flea market
markers.desc: One of the Vice City landmarks Rockstar named before launch.
